title: REB VM detector
summary: Current lexical JavaScript, decoded WASM, and retained runtime relevance scoring.
applicability: Authoritative implementation basis for the catalogued rules; the shared getter supplies current weights and profile.
limitations: Scores are heuristic. Static relevance scans unmasked text. No arbitrary guest semantics, full lexical parsing, or native origin allowlisting.
reuse_status: Project-owned implementation; no external code imported.

title: REA
summary: Evidence identities, explicit effects, coverage, and fail-closed comparison contracts.
applicability: Reference for local evidence and operation contracts; not a runtime dependency.
limitations: Inspected source is not an upstream test run. CLI/MCP architecture does not authorize adding MCP to REB.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: Ghostwire
summary: Runtime observations and finite-corpus candidate comparisons.
applicability: Reference for falsifiable comparisons; no oracle is supplied by this catalog.
limitations: Skipped cases weaken success claims. A blank page is not a denied-network sandbox; default capture is broader than REB policy.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: ReAgent
summary: Bounded candidate/checker workflows, typed differential checks, and digest-bound checkpoints.
applicability: Reference for explicit unknown gates; former auto-re-agent URL redirects here.
limitations: Binary reconstruction alpha; finite test matches are not program equivalence. No model SDK, emulator, or repair loop is adopted.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: Hyper Solutions plugin
summary: Client documentation describes hosted HAR analysis and progressive request facets.
applicability: Reference for separating analysis from repeatable output and for recorder-fidelity limits.
limitations: Hosted analyzer implementation was not inspectable. Vendor article performance is author-reported; no hosted upload, solver, or impersonation integration.
reuse_status: Manifest declares MIT, but reviewed tree lacks LICENSE; independently authored concepts only.

title: Withdrawn emro anti-bot article
summary: The current URL contains a withdrawal notice dated 2026-04-26.
applicability: Historical context only; it supports no technical rule in this catalog.
limitations: Removed implementation details and experiments cannot be verified from the current page. No archive reconstruction was attempted.
reuse_status: Reference only; no article text, samples, or source code redistributed.

title: antibot-detect
summary: Separates supplied-evidence classification from active retrieval and returns explanatory markers.
applicability: Concept reference for passive indications; current catalog does not add provider detection.
limitations: HIGH is an uncalibrated rule tier. Active impersonating fetches, cookie values, and merged-hop evidence are not adopted.
reuse_status: Declared MIT but no LICENSE in reviewed tree; independently authored concepts only.

title: SneakerDev research catalog
summary: Links to browser observation, VM, and analyzer-safety articles.
applicability: Discovery only; follow original sources before deriving implementation claims.
limitations: Aggregation headings do not establish present correctness, coverage, or authorization.
reuse_status: Reference only; no article text, samples, or source code redistributed.

title: Scrapfly audio fingerprint mathematics
summary: Reports small audio-output differences and discusses FFT numerical behavior.
applicability: Motivates sample-wise diagnostics, not hardware identification.
limitations: Measurements were not independently reproduced. Reviewed Chromium selects FFT libraries by Mac versus non-Mac, not ARM versus x86. No validated universal CPU classifier.
reuse_status: Reference only; no article text, samples, or source code redistributed.

title: Chromium FFT platform selection
summary: The reviewed interface selects Accelerate on Mac and PFFFT on non-Mac builds.
applicability: Primary implementation check on the audio article platform interpretation.
limitations: This build condition alone does not explain every numerical result; OS, engine, DSP, graph, build flags, and privacy settings remain confounders.
reuse_status: Reference only; Chromium source notices would need preservation for any later copying.

title: Web Audio specification
summary: Distinguishes offline buffer processing, float32 PCM samples, and real-time audio graphs.
applicability: Terminology for retained Web Audio call relevance; does not make call metadata into sample evidence.
limitations: Living unpinned specification reviewed on the stated date. A synthetic oscillator is not microphone capture; arbitrary imported buffers can contain personal content.
reuse_status: Reference only; no article text, samples, or source code redistributed.

title: web-re-toolkit
summary: AST VM triage, handler identity, decoded guest IR, codec checks, and repeated baselines.
applicability: Conceptual VM analysis and fixture reference; REB weights are independently owned.
limitations: Probing executes source. Coarse equivalence and value/time correlation do not prove semantics or taint; lifted long literals can be lossy. No runtime engine imported.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: Writing a JavaScript VM in Go companion
summary: Small register-machine compiler and interpreter with fetch, dispatch, state, and termination.
applicability: Educational structural model and original-fixture inspiration; no Go production dependency.
limitations: Supports a narrow JavaScript subset. Article ideas such as opcode permutation and runtime keys are not implemented by the companion.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: JSREI ast-hook-for-js-RE
summary: Transforms source to index runtime string values and support source/value searches.
applicability: Existing source-navigation workflow context.
limitations: Mutation, unbounded string retention, and wildcard messages are unsuitable as authoritative capture.
reuse_status: Empty LICENSE-WTFPL and NOASSERTION metadata; no copying.

title: JSREI js-cookie-monitor-debugger-hook
summary: Conditional page cookie setter observation and breakpoints.
applicability: Conditional-observation UX context only.
limitations: Misses server/HttpOnly and nested unhooked writes. Raw cookie capture is not adopted.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: JSREI js-script-hook
summary: Hooks dynamically created script URLs and selected JSONP callbacks.
applicability: Request-to-callback navigation context only.
limitations: One-shot page hook is incomplete loader coverage; hex length does not identify a cryptographic algorithm.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: JSREI eval-decoder
summary: Replaces eval during unpacking but invokes saved real eval on the supplied expression.
applicability: Negative safety example for inert analysis.
limitations: Submitted code can execute; no decoder execution is adopted.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: JSREI js-debugger-bypass
summary: Rewrites debugger substrings and wraps code-construction APIs.
applicability: Negative regression context for source-faithful transformations.
limitations: Can alter literals, identifiers, scope, and closures; no bypass implementation is adopted.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: JSREI page-redirect-code-location-hook
summary: Adds a beforeunload breakpoint.
applicability: Narrow intervention UX context.
limitations: A breakpoint does not establish general redirect provenance.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: JSREI ast-explorer-helper
summary: Adds AST Explorer expansion and clipboard conveniences.
applicability: Source-inspection UX context only.
limitations: No standalone parser is supplied; source upload to an external AST site is not adopted.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: JSREI js-xhr-hook-goat
summary: Local signed-query and encoded-request exercises.
applicability: Inspiration for small original local fixtures.
limitations: Reviewed query-sign client/server representations disagree; upstream examples are not a trusted test oracle.
reuse_status: MIT reviewed; concepts only, no upstream code copied for this catalog.

title: Rust binary32 representation
summary: Raw bit conversions, signed-zero comparison and NaN representation behavior.
applicability: Representation and exceptional-value policies for binary32-finite-steps-v1.
limitations: Published documentation reviewed on 2026-10-07, not an immutable revision. It does not define the REB finite-step metric or establish cross-platform computation identity.
reuse_status: Primary documentation reviewed; original REB code and fixtures, no source copied.

title: Oracle Solaris Studio 12.4 Numerical Computation Guide: Single Format
summary: Binary32 sign, exponent and fraction layout with normal/subnormal and exceptional encodings.
applicability: Bit classification and boundary fixtures for binary32-finite-steps-v1.
limitations: Format facts do not imply browser, CPU, DSP or fingerprint identity.
reuse_status: Primary documentation reviewed; original REB code and fixtures, no source copied.
